title: ServiceDefinition
description: Declarative mapping of an OSB service offering onto a Kubernetes custom resource managed by an external operator. One YAML document per marketplace service — config over code.

name.description: Internal identifier; also the ConfigMap key when bundled.

offering.description: How the service appears in the OSB catalog.

id.description: OSB service_id (UUID recommended). Stable across broker restarts.

name.description: Marketplace name shown to consumers (cf marketplace).

id.description: OSB plan_id. Must be unique within the offering.

params.description: Sizing knobs substituted into the provision template via {{ .plan.<key> }}.

allowedParameters.description: Whitelist of parameter keys a consumer may send in provision/update requests. Unknown keys are rejected with 400. Empty/absent = no user parameters allowed.

provision.description: Which custom resource to create per instance.

apiVersion.description: CRD apiVersion of the target operator.

template.description: Go text/template rendering to a full CR manifest. Data: {{ .instanceID }}/{{ .InstanceID }}, {{ .safeName }} (DNS-label-safe object name, always osb-prefixed), {{ .plan.* }}, {{ .bindingID }}, {{ .parameters }}. missingkey=error is enforced; both lowercase and Go-style field names are supported.

readiness.description: How to evaluate instance readiness for last_operation polling.

statusJSONPath.description: gjson path into the CR's status. Leading dot tolerated. Array filters use #(...) syntax.

expectedValue.description: Case-insensitive comparison against the resolved value. Missing path = not ready.

credentialsFromSecret.description: Go template for the secret name; usually '{{ .safeName }}-app' or similar operator convention.

credentialKeys.description: Optional whitelist of secret keys exposed as credentials. Absent = all keys.
